paper.title_en: \texttt{StochAXtic}: a JAX-Accelerated, End-to-End Differentiable Framework for Gravitational-Wave Backgrounds from Compact Binary Populations
paper.abstract_en: We present \texttt{StochAXtic}, a package for computing the dimensionless energy density spectrum $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ of the stochastic gravitational-wave background generated by compact binary coalescences. Rather than sampling binary populations via Monte Carlo, \texttt{StochAXtic} exploits the \emph{scale invariance} of the waveforms: at fixed mass ratio, spins and tidal deformabilities, the waveform depends on the total mass only through the dimensionless combination $Mf$. This allows all computationally expensive waveform evaluations using \texttt{LALSuite} to be performed once and stored in a population-independent lookup table. The subsequent integrals over mass and redshift can then be recast as convolutions and evaluated efficiently using fast Fourier transforms. We further employ truncated singular value decomposition to compress the lookup table, reducing both computational cost and memory requirements. Once the table has been computed and cached, \texttt{StochAXtic} evaluates $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ in a few milliseconds, achieving a relative numerical error below $10^{-3}$ at frequencies up to $1$ kHz. Its results agree with those of \texttt{popstock} within the latter's statistical uncertainties. Implemented entirely in \texttt{JAX}, \texttt{StochAXtic} also provides gradients of $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ with respect to population hyperparameters, enabling its direct integration with gradient-based inference methods including Hamiltonian Monte Carlo.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该工作提出用于计算致密双星并合随机引力波背景能量密度谱的JAX加速、端到端可微框架，利用波形标度不变性、查找表、FFT卷积与截断SVD压缩，并与popstock交叉验证，方法清晰、可复现性强，属于PTA/随机引力波背景计算方向，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: \texttt{StochAXtic}：一个JAX加速、端到端可微的致密双星族群引力波背景计算框架
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出 \texttt{StochAXtic}，这是一个用于计算由致密双星并合产生的随机引力波背景的无量纲能量密度谱 $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ 的程序包。\texttt{StochAXtic} 不对双星族群进行蒙特卡洛采样，而是利用波形的\emph{标度不变性}：在固定质量比、自旋和潮汐形变的情况下，波形仅通过无量纲组合 $Mf$ 依赖于总质量。这允许使用 \texttt{LALSuite} 进行的所有计算代价高昂的波形求值只执行一次并存储在族群无关的查找表中。随后，对质量和红移的积分可以重写为卷积，并使用快速傅里叶变换高效求值。我们进一步采用截断奇异值分解来压缩查找表，从而降低计算成本和内存需求。一旦该表被计算并缓存，\texttt{StochAXtic} 可在几毫秒内求值 $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$，在高达 $1$ kHz 的频率上实现低于 $10^{-3}$ 的相对数值误差。其结果与 \texttt{popstock} 的结果在后者的统计不确定度范围内一致。\texttt{StochAXtic} 完全用 \texttt{JAX} 实现，还提供 $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}(f)$ 对族群超参数的梯度，使其能够直接与包括哈密顿蒙特卡洛在内的基于梯度的推断方法集成。
